exact: disruption of host protein localisation to phagosome
inhibition of host protein localisation to phagosome
negative regulation by symbiont of host protein localization to phagocytic vesicle
suppression of host protein localisation to phagosome

definition: A process in which a symbiont inhibits or disrupts the normal localization of a protein to the host phagosome. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host protein localization to phagocytic vesicle
